# AgentPhone - Phone Numbers for AI Agents

Give AI agents their own phone numbers and identity to call and message across every channel.

AI agents are becoming incredibly capable online, but the moment you need one to make a phone call or send a text, everything falls apart. You end up stitching together telecom providers, voice infrastructure, compliance, routing, and your own memory layer. Giving an agent a phone number should be simple. It wasn't.

So we built AgentPhone: the telephony infrastructure layer for AI agents.  
  

### TL;DR:

### Who's Using It

Teams at Google's Agent Development Kit, Replit, Y Combinator, Sim AI, LangChain, and Alchemy are already building with AgentPhone.

### The Problem [...] ### The Problem

The $2T global telecom industry was built for humans. AI agents today can browse the web, write code, and manage entire workflows. But they still can't pick up the phone. A lot of business still runs on calls and texts, channels that existed before the internet and email. If agents are going to do real work, they need to work on the channels people already use.

### How It Works

AgentPhone gives developers a single API to provision phone numbers for their agents with voice and messaging built in and no compliance headaches. Just plug in and your agent can talk and text to the world.

# Phone numbers for AI voice agents

Your AI agent is built — now give it a real phone number. Local numbers in 100+ countries, delivered over SIP, connected to any AI platform, with no lock-in. From a carrier that operates the calls, not a reseller.

Talk to us Check coverage

Caller → PSTN → Temptera → SIP → your agent

Why it matters

## An AI agent is only as reachable as its number

Voice agents built on Vapi, Retell, ElevenLabs, OpenAI's Realtime API or LiveKit all need the same thing to actually make and receive calls: a phone number (a DID) and a SIP path to the phone network. Bundled platform numbers are often US-only, or tied to the platform you bought them from. [...] ### See coverage first

Check availability and number types before you commit — no sales gate to browse where your agent can have a presence.

FAQ

## Phone numbers for AI agents — answered

Want the detail? Read the full guide: virtual numbers for AI voice agents.

Do AI voice agents need a phone number?

Yes. To make or receive real phone calls, an AI voice agent needs a phone number (a DID) and a SIP connection to the phone network. Temptera provides both — the number and the SIP trunk that carries the call.

 Can I use my own number and SIP trunk with Vapi, Retell or ElevenLabs?

Yes. These platforms support bringing your own number or SIP trunk. You point a Temptera SIP trunk at your agent — authorised by IP address or by SIP credentials — and route your DID to it. [...] ### Registered SIP credentials

Or register a trunk with a username and password. For platforms and softswitches that authenticate by SIP digest.

### Inbound & outbound

Your DID brings calls in to the agent; the agent sends calls out over the same trunk, presenting your chosen caller ID. Standard G.711 / G.722 audio.

Connection details and credentials are provisioned privately to your account — never published here.

Works with your stack

## Bring your own number to any AI platform

If it speaks SIP, it works with Temptera. A number and trunk you own, plugged into the agent framework you already chose.

### Vapi

Register a Temptera trunk as a custom BYO SIP credential and attach your DID — by IP or SIP auth.

## What Agents With Phone Numbers Can Do

### Answer Every Call, 24/7

An AI receptionist that picks up on the first ring, understands what the caller needs, books appointments, answers FAQs, and sends a summary text after every call. No hold music. No "press 1 for sales." No missed calls at 2am.

### Call Leads Before They Go Cold [...] ### Bridge Digital and Physical

An agent monitoring your e-commerce store notices a spike in returns for a specific product. It calls the supplier, asks about the batch, and reports back. Or it texts customers who abandoned checkout with a personalized follow-up. The agent moves between digital systems and human conversations seamlessly.

## How AgentPhone Makes It Simple

We built AgentPhone because this shouldn't require a telephony degree. Through a single MCP connection, any AI agent can buy phone numbers, make and receive calls, send and receive SMS, and get full transcripts, without touching SIP, RTP, or Twilio.
